emotional_detail: Michael actively building and directing. Deep engagement with lesson archaeology and consolidation. Positive energy throughout — excited about seeing 15 sources merged into one.
system_design_insights: 15-source consolidation pattern works: parallel code searches across repos → read source files → merge into single canonical doc → dual-publish. Repeatable.
Lesson style tracks codified: cyberpunk (Orbitron + Rajdhani, neon glow) and glassmorphism (Inter, glass cards). Both use Gospel 444 palette.
10-5-5-3 Protocol, Michael Method 4 Pillars, and Lesson Physics now in one place — no more hunting across vault fragments.
New lessons can be spun up from existing templates with vocab swap + theme adjustment. Signal Decode built from scratch as proof.
